title: Pumzika kama bondia kwenye gongo: unapopumzika, pumzika na kila kitu ulicho nacho

text.Rest like a boxer at the gong: when you: Pumzika kama bondia kwenye gongo: unapopumzika, pumzika na kila kitu ulicho nacho
text.When you get home, listen to the sound o: Unapofika nyumbani, sikiliza sauti ya gongo vizuri.
text.Rest properly, the way a boxer hears the: Pumzika vizuri, jinsi bondia anavyosikia gongo na kupumzika.
text.A boxer who keeps moving during the brea: Bondia anayeendelea kusonga mbele wakati wa mapumziko hawezi kushinda mechi.
text.Just like a boxer rests when the gong ri: Kama vile bondia anapumzika gongo inapolia, unapopumzika, unapumzika na kila kitu ulicho nacho.
text.When I get home, I fill the bath right a: Ninaporudi nyumbani, ninajaza kuoga mara moja, na nimeamua kupumzika.
text.When I do not know what to do, I just do: Wakati sijui la kufanya, mimi hufanya tu kitu kinachomsaidia mtu
text.When someone gets angry at me, I focus o: Mtu anaponikasirikia mimi huwa nazingatia badala ya kujilaumu
